research_decision: Target a costed full-depth low-only nonlinear three-cycle action with inverse-polynomial moved mass and polynomial original supply at d=r-1, q=poly(n). Shallow perfect acceptance is already achieved by the existing sieve; its recursive fan-in is the problem. Canonicalization of three orbit words plus reversible reconstruction erases the original index without global fiber ranking or compressed tags. Exponential atlases and cheap tiny-coverage affine actions are controls, not solutions.

proof_obligations.PO-ACTION: Construct a globally consistent tau with tau^3=id and exact native prefix invariance. Finding a partner for each word does not guarantee order three.
proof_obligations.PO-ACCESS: Supply a clean coherent evaluator of tau and clean controlled forms with actual polynomial circuit cost and workspace. Control of an unknown unitary is not granted. A reference table or uncharged counting/witness oracle is not access.
proof_obligations.PO-LOW: The complete action policy reads only public low frequency rows; otherwise derive a new conditional high-lift output law.
proof_obligations.PO-COVERAGE: Prove inverse-polynomial nonfixed word mass on the actual IID native label law. Charge failures, independently refreshed source batches and one output per accepted batch.
proof_obligations.PO-DEPTH: Demonstrate full-depth polynomial supply and polynomial evaluator cost, not just the known perfectly accepting one-root sieve. Compare with both its fresh-batch supply ledger and scoped disjoint one-output lower bound; do not turn either into a generic lower bound.
proof_obligations.PO-CLEAN: Compute the minimum of three orbit words, copy the logical position and success flag, uncompute all scratch, reconstruct tau^t(u), erase the original word and reverse reconstruction scratch. Uncompressed M-trit tags are allowed.
proof_obligations.PO-CHILD: Check actual full-root phase differences, secret-independent raw tag mass3^(1-M), pointed unit minor and conditional IID child law. Fresh batches are required.
proof_obligations.PO-ERROR: Provide a coherent whole-instrument error bound through all constant-count evaluator and inverse calls. Basis correctness alone is insufficient; success conditioning amplifies errors.
proof_obligations.PO-SCOPE: This is a sufficient basis-permutation construction, not a characterization of arbitrary quantum receivers. Noncommuting and source-state approximate routes remain open.
proof_obligations.PO-REVIEW: External review and novelty checks are pending. No efficient nonlinear cycle action, speedup or LWE attack is supplied.

falsifiers: A true native word belongs to a two-cycle or changes prefix under tau.
Canonical coordinates fail to reconstruct the original word or leave index garbage.
A claimed fast evaluator loads or searches an exponential atlas.
Moved mass is tiny on typical labels despite a few positive controls.
Output phases, raw probability or conditional high-lift law differ from the claimed native child.
